entities.title: Recording format
entities.summary: { mode, players, seed, steps, log }: what the browser records and the Worker replays.
consumers: worker/scores.ts, through POST /api/score (which takes it without the seed)
guarantees: mode is coop or versus; players 1 to 9; seed a 32-bit unsigned whole number
steps counts every step played, up to and including the one that ended the game, at most 324,000 (90 minutes)
log is flat triples [steps since the previous change, player, controls as bits], in order, at most 750,000 numbers
Controls as bits: left 1, right 2, thrust 4, fire 8, blink 16
entities.compatibility: Any change to game.ts, config.ts, dmath.ts or rng.ts changes what a recording replays to. Scores already on the table are not replayed again, and a game in progress during a deploy may be refused. The bit order is shared with online play (src/main.ts sends toBits over the lockstep).
